items.briefing:
Australia and New Zealand are experiencing a surge in critical software vulnerabilities, meaning organisations here face a higher risk of systems being compromised. Security experts are highlighting network segmentation as a key defence — by separating different parts of your internal network, attackers who do gain access are limited in how far they can move. Online scams also continue to be a growing problem, with elaborate fraud operations becoming increasingly hard to distinguish from legitimate communications.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email or message asking you to click a link or provide details, verify it by contacting the sender directly through a known phone number — not any contact details in the message itself.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Critical patch backlogs leave Australian organisations exposed to 85 high-impact security flaws.
